metadata.title: WorkHard — Show and hide windows in a tap
metadata.description: Reveal and hide reference windows with hotkey, hover, and toggle. A precise desktop productivity tool — multi-monitor and high-DPI aware.

hero.subtitle1: Four modes to reveal and hide windows freely.
hero.subtitle2: Stay focused. References, only when you need them.

demo.subtitle: No complicated setup. Follow the guide and your windows will show and hide on their own.

steps.title: Pick a window
steps.desc: Choose the window you want to show or hide. You can pick more than one at the same time.

steps.title: When should it show?
steps.desc: Pick when the window appears — hotkey, hover, combined, or toggle.

steps.title: Fine-tune the look
steps.desc: Lock the aspect ratio, keep it on top, and set the hidden and visible transparency just how you like.

steps.title: Start
steps.desc: You're all set! Windows show or hide on their own based on your rules.

modes.subtitle: Visible when you need it, gone when you don't. Different moments need different behavior. Pick freely from four modes designed for your flow.

items.name: Hotkey
items.desc: Visible only while you hold the shortcut. Release to hide — never breaking your flow.

items.name: Hover
items.desc: Cursor enters the area — visible. Leaves — hidden. A natural transition with almost no movement.

items.name: Both
items.desc: Visible only when both shortcut and hover are active. Perfect to prevent accidental exposure.

items.name: Toggle
items.desc: Press once to pin open, press again to dismiss. Great for references you keep around.
items.example: Press Ctrl + Space once → Stays visible

features.subtitle: A small, light tool that's rock-solid inside. Runs reliably across any Windows desktop.

items.title: Smooth transparency
items.desc: Fades from 0% to 100% with no flicker — naturally hidden, naturally back.

items.title: High-DPI precision
items.desc: Mouse-pointed spots align perfectly with windows — even on 4K or multi-monitor setups.

items.title: Lock to any ratio
items.desc: Save common ratios like 16:9, 21:9, 4:3 — snap to them with one click.

items.title: Many windows, one action
items.desc: Register many windows; one trigger moves them all in sync.

items.title: Safe auto-update
items.desc: Fetched only from trusted sources, with multi-step integrity checks before install.

items.title: Dark · Light auto-switch
items.desc: Detects your system theme; switches between Korean and English instantly.

download.subtitle: Free on Windows 10 and up. The installer goes through integrity checks before installing.

instructions.warning: ⚠ The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen or your antivirus may flag it. That's expected — follow the steps below.
steps: Click 'Download for Windows' above to fetch the installer.
If 'Windows protected your PC' appears, click 'More info' → 'Run anyway'.
If your antivirus blocks the file, allow or trust it, then try again.
Once the integrity check passes, installation begins automatically.

footer.description: Windows that surface only when needed. Keep your flow — and your references — at once.
